lesson.subtitle: Lesson 2 -- Our Company
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ender de Souza Batista | Lesson 2 -- Our Company
lesson.grammar_point: there is / there are (affirmative, negative and questions)

listenings.text: Hi, and welcome to our office in New York. We are a small fintech. There are two floors. On the first floor, there is a small coffee shop, and there are tables for clients. On the second floor, there is the technology team. There are twenty people on the team. There is not a big meeting room, but there are four small rooms for calls. Okay, let's go up.

Hello, I am Priya. I am an engineer at a bank in Mumbai, in India. My bank is very big. There are offices in every city, and there are many stores that use our cards. There is a team for credit cards, and I am on that team. There are many calls with partners in other countries. My English is good, but my accent is from India!

extra_audio.text: You pay for a coffee with a credit card. Behind that card, there is a lot of work. There are banks, partners and a lot of software. Ender's company makes software for payments. There are many clients: banks, fintechs and stores.

vocab.title: Match each word to its meaning
defs: a company that keeps and lends money
a plastic card: you pay now and pay the bank later
the place where people work, with desks and computers
a place where people buy things
a person or a company that buys from you

paras: You buy a coffee and you pay with a credit card. It is fast and easy. But behind that card, there is a lot of work. There are banks, there are partners like Visa and Mastercard, and there is a lot of software.
Ender works at a technology company in São Paulo. There is an office in São Paulo, and there is a technology team. Ender is the director. The company makes software and services for payments.

There are many clients: there are banks, there are fintechs and there are stores. There is not a lot of English every day. But there are calls with partners in other countries, and on those calls, the language is English.
